facts.fact: Wacker 把 Helga Q. FLYSPECK 介绍给 KRAY 认识。
facts.anchor: I want you to meet Helga Q. FLYSPECK. FLYSPECK, Andre B. KRAY.

facts.fact: FLYSPECK 身高约五英尺三英寸，看起来约五十九岁半。
facts.anchor: stood just about five foot three and appeared to be right around fifty-nine and a half years old

facts.fact: FLYSPECK 长着一双不满的黑曼巴蛇般的眼睛。
facts.anchor: She had the eyes of a disgruntled black mamba.

facts.fact: FLYSPECK 认为每两名 GOOWIKI NOC 配一名、共五百名新经理能解决问题。
facts.anchor: FLYSPECK thinks five hundred new managers, one for every two GOOWIKI NOCs, ought to take care of the problem.

facts.fact: Wacker 说还需要更大的会议室和更多金条。
facts.anchor: Also, we’re gonna need a bigger conference room and more gold bars.

facts.fact: KRAY 回到电脑前用 Sametime 联系 BUTTONFLY。
BUTTONFLY 说 FLYSPECK 过去的常规提案是增加七十五人。
facts.anchor: Used to be her standard proposal was seventy-five new bodies.

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说总部第二条规则是绕开问题，第一条规则是小心选择要打的仗。
facts.anchor: That’s the number two rule to keep in mind at Headquarters. And the number one rule is to pick your fights carefully.
